title: A Mechanism Is Not a Cause

scenes.tts: If a drug that blocks serotonin uptake helps depression, was low serotonin the cause?
scenes.visual: Title fades. A pill icon beside a serotonin transporter, and a question mark beside a brain.
scenes.narration: If a drug that blocks serotonin uptake helps depression, was low serotonin the cause?

scenes.tts: Start with what is established. S S R I drugs block the serotonin transporter, in the pocket where serotonin binds.
scenes.caption: Start with what is established. SSRI drugs block the serotonin transporter, in the pocket where serotonin binds.
scenes.visual: The SERT structure; zoom into the central site, where a paroxetine model sits where serotonin would bind. Card: SSRIs block SERT. Established.
scenes.narration: Start with what is established. SSRI drugs block the serotonin transporter, in the pocket where serotonin binds.

scenes.tts: In 1990, Pedro Delgado and colleagues ran a blinded experiment.
scenes.visual: A crossover diagram builds. Label: Delgado and colleagues, 1990.
scenes.narration: In 1990, Pedro Delgado and colleagues ran a blinded experiment.

scenes.tts: They studied 21 patients whose depression had remitted on antidepressants.
scenes.visual: A grid of 21 figures. Label: remitted on antidepressants.
scenes.narration: They studied 21 patients whose depression had remitted on antidepressants.

scenes.tts: Each received a drink with no tryptophan, serotonin's building block, and on another occasion a control drink.
scenes.visual: Two arms of the diagram: a drink labelled tryptophan-free, with a side note (tryptophan, the precursor of serotonin), and a drink labelled control. Arrows show each patient crossing over to both.
scenes.narration: Each received a drink with no tryptophan, serotonin's building block, and on another occasion a control drink.

scenes.tts: Neither the patient nor the rater knew which drink was which.
scenes.visual: Both drink labels are covered by blindfold icons over the patient and the rater.
scenes.narration: Neither the patient nor the rater knew which drink was which.

scenes.tts: After the tryptophan-free drink, 14 of the 21 relapsed.
scenes.visual: 14 of the 21 figures turn grey. On screen: 14 of 21 relapsed.
scenes.narration: After the tryptophan-free drink, 14 of the 21 relapsed.

scenes.tts: They returned to remission within one to two days on normal food.
scenes.visual: The grey figures regain colour. On screen: back in remission over 24 to 48 hours.
scenes.narration: They returned to remission within one to two days on normal food.

scenes.tts: The control drink had no significant effect.
scenes.visual: The control arm: a group summary card reads no significant effect.
scenes.narration: The control drink had no significant effect.

scenes.tts: Does this show that low serotonin causes depression?
scenes.visual: On screen: Does this show that low serotonin causes depression? A five-second countdown ring.
scenes.narration: Does this show that low serotonin causes depression?

scenes.tts: It does not. These patients were chosen because an antidepressant had helped them.
scenes.visual: The 21 figures are circled with a label: selected because a drug helped.
scenes.narration: It does not. These patients were chosen because an antidepressant had helped them.

scenes.tts: The result suggests that some of them needed serotonin to stay well. A treatment can depend on a transmitter that was never low.
scenes.visual: Two cards side by side: Some treated patients may need serotonin to stay well. Serotonin was never shown to be low.
scenes.narration: The result suggests that some of them needed serotonin to stay well. A treatment can depend on a transmitter that was never low.

scenes.tts: Pooled depletion studies split people by risk. Healthy volunteers without a family history showed no significant mood drop. Those with one dropped slightly. Drug free people recovered from depression dropped more.
scenes.visual: Three labelled groups, drawn qualitatively with no bar heights: healthy, no family history: no significant drop. Healthy, family history: slight drop. Drug-free, recovered from depression: moderate drop.
scenes.narration: Pooled depletion studies split people by risk. Healthy volunteers without a family history showed no significant mood drop. Those with one dropped slightly. Drug-free people recovered from depression dropped more.
scenes.caption: Pooled depletion studies split people by risk. Healthy volunteers without a family history showed no significant mood drop. Those with one dropped slightly. Drug-free people recovered from depression dropped more.

scenes.tts: A 2022 review found no consistent support for a low serotonin cause. Other researchers dispute its methods.
scenes.caption: A 2022 review found no consistent support for a low-serotonin cause. Other researchers dispute its methods.
scenes.visual: Card: 2022 umbrella review, no consistent support for a low-serotonin cause. A smaller note: methods disputed.
scenes.narration: A 2022 review found no consistent support for a low-serotonin cause. Other researchers dispute its methods.

scenes.tts: Meanwhile, a 2018 analysis of trials found 21 antidepressants better than placebo, for acute major depression in adults. Certainty ranged from moderate to very low.
scenes.visual: Card: 2018 network meta-analysis. Adults, acute major depression: 21 antidepressants better than placebo; certainty moderate to very low.
scenes.narration: Meanwhile, a 2018 analysis of trials found 21 antidepressants better than placebo, for acute major depression in adults. Certainty ranged from moderate to very low.

scenes.tts: Both can be true. Aspirin relieves a headache, yet headaches are not caused by a lack of aspirin.
scenes.visual: An aspirin tablet beside a head with a fading headache.
scenes.narration: Both can be true. Aspirin relieves a headache, yet headaches are not caused by a lack of aspirin.

scenes.tts: Still, the tryptophan experiment suggests that some treated patients need serotonin to stay well.
scenes.visual: The Delgado diagram returns briefly with the 14 relapses highlighted.
scenes.narration: Still, the tryptophan experiment suggests that some treated patients need serotonin to stay well.

scenes.tts: The takeaway: a drug's mechanism is evidence about the drug. It is not proof of what causes the disease.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: A mechanism is evidence about the drug, not proof of a disease's cause.
scenes.narration: The takeaway: a drug's mechanism is evidence about the drug. It is not proof of what causes the disease.
